final: WITH per AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 THEN gbsize * 1.0 / spanmin END) AS gbpm FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), allavg AS (SELECT AVG(gbpm) AS a FROM per WHERE gbpm IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(total_scans) AS avg_total_scans, AVG(gbpm) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(gbpm - (SELECT a FROM allavg)) AS avg_margin FROM per WHERE gbpm > (SELECT a FROM allavg)
